title.zh: 【Uniswap Aggregator Hooks 上线，可封装外部流动性来源转化为 v4 流动性池】
title.en: 【Uniswap Aggregator Hooks 上线，可封装外部流动性来源转化为 v4 流动性池】

current_state.zh: Uniswap v4 Aggregator Hooks 已上线，覆盖以太坊主网、Base 与 Robinhood Chain，首日支持 Curve、Fluid、PancakeSwap 等七个外部来源；经其路由的兑换将收取协议费并贡献于 UNI 销毁。
current_state.en: Uniswap v4 Aggregator Hooks are live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain, initially supporting seven external sources including Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap; swaps routed through them incur protocol fees contributing to UNI burns.

updates.title_zh: 【Uniswap Aggregator Hooks 上线，可封装外部流动性来源转化为 v4 流动性池】
updates.title_en: 【Uniswap Aggregator Hooks 上线，可封装外部流动性来源转化为 v4 流动性池】
updates.what_changed_zh: Uniswap 推出 Aggregator Hooks，使 v4 能将 Curve、Fluid 和 PancakeSwap 等外部流动性来源接入 v4 流动性池，已通过 Uniswap Web 应用和 API 在以太坊主网、Base 和 Robinhood Chain 上线。
updates.what_changed_en: Uniswap launched Aggregator Hooks, letting v4 wrap external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap into v4 liquidity pools, live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain via the Uniswap Web app and API.
updates.current_state_zh: Uniswap 推出 Aggregator Hooks，使 v4 能将 Curve、Fluid 和 PancakeSwap 等外部流动性来源接入 v4 流动性池，已通过 Uniswap Web 应用和 API 在以太坊主网、Base 和 Robinhood Chain 上线。
updates.current_state_en: Uniswap launched Aggregator Hooks, letting v4 wrap external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap into v4 liquidity pools, live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain via the Uniswap Web app and API.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Uniswap launched Aggregator Hooks, letting v4 wrap external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap into v4 liquidity pools, live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain via the Uniswap Web app and API.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Uniswap launched Aggregator Hooks, letting v4 wrap external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap into v4 liquidity pools, live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain via the Uniswap Web app and API.
updates.background_zh: Uniswap v4 于 2025 年 1 月上线主网，引入 Hook、单例合约设计与闪 accounting（闪电记账）机制。Hook 允许开发者给资金池附加自定义逻辑，而 Aggregator Hooks 是首次用该机制将路由接入其他协议的流动性，而不仅是 Uniswap 自身资金池。
updates.background_en: Uniswap v4 launched on mainnet in January 2025, introducing hooks, the singleton contract design and flash accounting. Hooks let developers attach custom logic to pools, and Aggregator Hooks is the first use of that mechanism to route into other protocols' liquidity rather than only Uniswap's own pools.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次发布直接作用于 DEX 聚合器这一细分市场：Uniswap v4 现在可以通过自身路由吸收 Curve、Fluid、PancakeSwap 等场所的报价，聚合器订单流与手续费捕获由此向 Uniswap 网页端与 API 转移。对 UNI 而言，传导渠道是经外部来源路由的兑换所缴纳的协议费进入销毁，使代币供应不仅取决于 Uniswap 原生池活动，也对聚合交易量敏感。
updates.market_impact_en: The release touches the DEX aggregator segment directly: Uniswap v4 can now absorb quotes from venues such as Curve, Fluid and PancakeSwap through its own router, so aggregator order flow and fee capture shift toward Uniswap's Web app and API. For UNI, the transmission channel is the protocol fee on externally routed swaps feeding the burn, making token supply sensitive to aggregator volume rather than only to Uniswap-native pool activity.

updates.what_changed_zh: 上线首日支持七个外部来源（包括 Curve、Fluid、PancakeSwap）；经外部来源路由的兑换将收取协议费并贡献于 UNI 销毁；每区块拉取最新报价并在单笔交易内完成结算，无需新增授权。
updates.what_changed_en: Adds that the launch supports seven external sources on day one, including Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap; swaps routed through external sources incur protocol fees contributing to UNI burns; quotes refresh each block and settle in a single transaction without new approvals.

updates.current_state_en: Uniswap v4 Aggregator Hooks are live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain, initially supporting seven external sources including Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap; swaps routed through them incur protocol fees contributing to UNI burns.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Uniswap launched v4 Aggregator Hooks, letting external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap be wrapped as v4 pools and routed through Uniswap on Ethereum, Base, and Robinhood Chain, with swap fees contributing to UNI burns.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Uniswap launched v4 Aggregator Hooks, letting external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap be wrapped as v4 pools and routed through Uniswap on Ethereum, Base, and Robinhood Chain, with swap fees contributing to UNI burns.
